source_policy: runtime cache generated from the user's read-only Fallout 2 DAT archives

modes.directional_6: six FRM rotations selected from actor facing and camera bearing
modes.billboard_y: single source view rotates around the vertical axis toward the camera
modes.billboard_screen: single source view fully faces the camera
modes.billboard_fixed: source view remains aligned to the MAP object rotation
modes.billboard_cross: two perpendicular source planes for sparse vegetation
modes.ground_decal: source view lies just above the floor

quality.alpha: palette index 0 becomes transparent; alpha scissor in Godot

architecture_policy: buildings, walls, floors, stairs and ceilings remain reconstructed geometry; actors use six directional views; compact freestanding props and single-view furniture such as chests, vases and temple benches use source billboards with MAP-derived or separate physical collision; unknown scenery stays hidden until classified
